narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Printed Working"**

The page is a deep navy desk with one roll of white printing-calculator tape running down it. The words sit on the navy and make the argument; the tape prints the arithmetic beside them in black ink, with adjustments in red, and a reviewer initials the result with a red hand tick. A valuation is a sum the owner can check, so the page shows the sum being done rather than a product screenshot.

This record covers the public marketing site only: `web/app/(marketing)/*` and `web/components/marketing/*`. The home page (`web/app/(marketing)/page.tsx`) is the first full expression of the tape world, and the shared header and footer are already in it. The other marketing routes (`/valuation`, `/blog`, the Markdown pages) sit inside the same shell but their page bodies still use the older `marketing-*` classes in `web/app/globals.css`. The signed-in product (`/reports`, `/wizard`, `/admin` and the rest) still uses the older styles in `web/app/globals.css` and is not part of this world yet. Do not apply these rules there until someone decides to move it.

Every token below is scoped to `.marketing-page` in `web/components/marketing/marketing.css`, so the product app is untouched. The direction contract that set this world is kept as the `DESIGN_CONTRACT` comment in `web/app/layout.tsx`. Where that contract and the build differ, this file follows the build.
keyCharacteristics: Two materials only: navy desk and white tape. Nothing else has a surface.
Compressed heavy Archivo for headings, a typewriter face for anything the machine prints.
Red is ink on paper: adjustments, the fee, the reviewer's name and tick.
One roll runs the full length of the page on desktop and tears into strips on a phone.
One animated moment: the tape feeds out of the printer and gets initialled.

rules.name: The Red Ink Rule
rules.body: Red appears only on paper, as ink. Never set red text, red icons or red fills on the navy. If a figure needs to stand out on navy, it goes on a piece of tape.

rules.name: The Two Surfaces Rule
rules.body: A surface is either navy desk or white paper. There are no grey cards, tinted panels or gradients on the desk. Anything that should stand out from the navy becomes paper (the stub, the "ours" comparison row, the primary button).

rules.name: The Machine Voice Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime is only for what the calculator would print: figures and labels on the tape and the stub, and on the navy only where the words repeat or count the way the tape does (the gloss lines that quote tape labels, the step numerals, post dates). Never use it for headings, paragraphs, buttons or navigation.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Headings are compressed with `font-stretch`, never with a second condensed family. Stay between 62 percent (hero) and 80 percent (small titles and wordmark). Body copy stays at normal width.

rules.name: The Paper On Desk Rule
rules.body: Only paper casts a shadow. Text, rules and the navy itself stay flat.

dos: **Do** put any number the reader should check on the tape, in Courier Prime, with the working that produces it.
**Do** use the `adjust` tone for every line that changes the figure, and close each print with one `total` or `final`.
**Do** keep each band's tape cell in the right-hand 400px column so the roll stays continuous on desktop.
**Do** tear the roll into separate strips at 960px and below, each under the copy it belongs to, each with a torn edge.
**Do** write figures and arithmetic that actually add up; a comment in `page.tsx` shows the sums for the sample.
**Do** keep the tape and stub as real text (definition lists), never an image of text.
**Do** keep any new motion inside `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`.
donts: **Don't** set red text, red icons or red backgrounds on the navy. Red is ink on paper.
**Don't** use Courier Prime for headings, paragraphs, buttons or navigation.
**Don't** add a third surface colour, grey cards or gradient panels to the desk.
**Don't** add a second animated moment. The feed and the tick are the one.
**Don't** add a product screenshot or a row of icon cards to a hero; the direction contract rejects the navy-and-white SaaS hero by name.
**Don't** carry these tokens into the signed-in product by hand. It is outside this world until it is moved deliberately.
